messages:
deploybot: Scheduled v2 rollout for service "api-gateway" at 2025-01-12T22:00Z (in ~3h). Release: r-20250112-v2. Canary plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% every 10m. Ops: @ellie @rob. Reply with `ack` to take ownership. /deploy r-20250112-v2 --canary --ops-watch
ellie: ack. I'll be primary ops. Will run initial canary in us-east-1 on a 5-host slice then widen if green. Watching JVM GC and connection errors specifically.
rob: ack. I'll handle rollback if we hit criteria. Added a quick checklist to runbook and pinned operator phone numbers.
kim: Heads-up: this release normalizes header case for `X-Client-Id` -> `x-client-id` and tightens token TTL handling from 30m->20m. Need to call out in release notes and customer comms. Any clients pinned to v1?
nate: There are ~8 tenants pinned to v1 until 2025-02-01 (billing and gov-tenants). We'll not flip those until manual opt-in. We'll surface them as `x-client-pin: v1` in logs.
docsbot: Release notes updated: https://go/release/r-20250112. Added migration steps and example cURL. Also created a short customer-blurb for the dashboard.
ellie: Preflight smoke example (staging):
```bash
curl -s -H "x-api-version: 2" https://staging.api.gateway/health | jq .status
```
Expect: "status": "ok" and header `x-runtime: redwood/1`
rob: Rollback triggers (proposed):
- 5xx ratio >= 1% sustained for 8m OR
- p95 latency +200ms over baseline for 15m OR
- schema validation errors tagged `response_schema` >= 40 in 10m
If any trigger: immediate rollback to r-20241201-v1, open #incidents, and set release state `reverted`.
kim: SDK note: server-to-server libs will send `x-api-version: 2` in 2.3.0 patch; mobile teams are shipping a soft-fallback that retries once with v1 for legacy devices.
oncall-bot: Canary alert rules created: `canary_v2_alerts`. Pager rule: notify @oncall if 5xx > 0.4% in 5m or error delta > 30 in 5m. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/canary-v2
deploybot: Dry-run scheduled at 2025-01-12T21:50Z (10m before). Command: `/deploy r-20250112-v2 --dry-run`
ellie: I'll kick the dry-run 10m before and post smoke screenshots. If dry-run passes, I'll start canary at scheduled time.
rob: Also note: pinlist updated so deploybot will not touch tenant pins unless `--force-unpin` is passed. We should avoid force-unpin for this release.
deploybot: Dry-run executed. Logs: https://go/logs/r-20250112-dryrun  smoke tests OK.
nate: Analytics plan: tag requests from legacy clients as `client_version:legacy` so we can track error surface. Will send dashboard share at T+10.
ellie: Good. If no blockers after dry-run I'll move this to #release-ready at +25m. :thumbsup:
rob: Aye. I'll be watching /dashboards/api-v2-rollout and will post T+10, T+30 snapshots. Ready to execute rollback steps if needed. :eyes:
